Apply Now

Your brighter future starts here.

Real-World Degrees

UAB’s academic programs are useful and are designed to prepare you for today's careers. Our expert faculty provide a supportive learning environment, and our location in the state's largest metro area means you're blocks away from jobs and internships.

Browse Degrees Undergraduate Programs Graduate Programs Online Programs
 
 

Turning Potential Into Purpose

Your future is yours to define. Why fit the mold when you can forge your own? Because knowledge doesn’t have walls, and neither do we. Our focus is on making an impact, from careers to communities.

$915M In Research Expenditures FY 25
280+ Degree and Certificate Programs
$12.1B Annual Economic Impact

Meet UAB graduates who are reaching their own career potential.

Read their Stories

The Future Is at UAB. Shouldn’t You Be?

Located in the largest metro in the state, we’re just blocks away from the jobs, internships, and opportunities that will put your degree to work before you even graduate. Our academic advisors and renowned faculty are here to support you on your journey.

Apply Undergraduate Cost & Aid Opens an external link. Undergraduate Scholarships Opens an external link. Graduate Admissions Opens an external link. International Admissions Opens an external link.

Our Blazer Spirit Burns Bright

At UAB, you can have it all: 450+ student organizations, engaging events, robust athletics programs, service opportunities, and hundreds of employers right outside your door.

About UAB Student Life Opens an external link. Athletics Opens an external link. Blazer Core Curriculum Opens an external link.

Lighting the Way

Our integrated research and clinical platforms ensure that discoveries in the lab translate to patient care at the bedside. And our robust entrepreneurial and innovation ecosystem turns ideas into commercial ventures. In all we do, we are committed to improving people's lives.
